messages:
elaine: Heads-up: a few customers reported incorrect billing when an internal fallback route is hit. Console shows the request under "fallback" instead of the org.
raj: Repro?
elaine: Send `X-RD-Route: org-A` and trigger capacity fallback -> ledger attributes to fallback bucket.
morgan: That happens because our proxy strips route metadata on variant fallback to avoid leaking internal route keys.
sam: We can either preserve a hashed route id or send route plaintext. Plaintext is a no-go. Propose hash: `X-RD-Route-Hash` + `X-RD-Route-Key` (version). Backend keeps hash->org mapping.
elaine: SDKs need an opt-in flag so we don't change defaults. DevEx should ship helpers for python/ts/go.
raj: Also need key rotation support and a grace period so old hashes remain valid for aggregation during rollouts.
morgan: I'll update ingestion to accept route_hash and key version, with dedupe. Add alerts if old keys used after grace.
sam: DevEx note: add env var `RD_PRESERVE_ROUTE_FALLBACK=true` and helper in sdks that sets `X-RD-Preserve-Route: 1`. Default false.
devex-bot: action: will open py/ts/go helper PRs and add changelog entry.
elaine: UX: console feature flag per-org + audit log when enabled. Plan: canary next week for 10% orgs, then 50% -> 100% over two weeks.
raj: Test plan: unit + e2e against canary proxy that performs HMAC. Ensure no PII in telemetry.
morgan: Timeline: backend + console (2 sprints), SDK releases (1 sprint), coordinated rollout.
elaine: Thanks — scheduling a 20m sync tomorrow. Drop PR links here when ready.
